mapper.insert: INSERT INTO challenge ( owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{challengeType}, #{inviteCode}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at FROM challenge WHERE id = #{challengeId}
SELECT id, owner_id, name, challenge_type, invite_code, status, created_at FROM challenge WHERE UPPER(TRIM(invite_code)) = #{inviteCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT ranked.challenge_id, ranked.user_id, ranked.week_start_date, ranked.rank_position, ranked.nickname, ranked.profile_image_url, ranked.saving_amount, ranked.streak_days, ranked.like_count, CASE WHEN ranked.rank_position = 1 THEN 2000 WHEN ranked.rank_position = 2 THEN 1000 WHEN ranked.rank_position = 3 THEN 800 WHEN ranked.rank_position BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 500 ELSE 0 END AS reward_point FROM ( SELECT summary.challenge_id, summary.user_id, summary.week_start_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY summary.challenge_id, summary.week_start_date ORDER BY summary.saving_amount DESC, summary.like_count DESC, summary.user_id ) AS rank_position, summary.nickname, summary.profile_image_url, summary.saving_amount, summary.streak_days, summary.like_count FROM ( SELECT challenge.id AS challenge_id, users.id AS user_id, CAST(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AS DATE) AS week_start_date, users.nickname, users.profile_image_url, COALESCE(SUM(feed.saving_amount), 0) AS saving_amount, users.streak_days, COALESCE(SUM(feed.like_count), 0) AS like_count FROM CHALLENGE challenge INNER JOIN USERS users ON users.current_challenge_id = challenge.id LEFT JOIN FEED feed ON feed.challenge_id = challenge.id AND feed.user_id = users.id AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL AND feed.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND feed.created_at < DATE_ADD( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY ) WHERE challenge.id = #{challengeId} GROUP BY challenge.id, users.id, users.nickname, users.profile_image_url, users.streak_days ) summary ) ranked ORDER BY ranked.rank_position, ranked.user_id

SELECT users.id AS user_id, users.nickname, users.profile_image_url, DATE(users.created_at) AS joined_at, users.streak_days, users.current_challenge_id, challenge.name AS current_challenge_name, COALESCE(feed_stats.total_saving_amount, 0) AS total_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.current_month_saving_amount, 0) AS current_month_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 0) AS previous_month_saving_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( (feed_stats.current_month_saving_amount - feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount) * 100.0 / feed_stats.previous_month_saving_amount, 1 ) END AS saving_change_rate, COALESCE(feed_stats.verification_count, 0) AS verification_count, COALESCE(feed_stats.average_saving_amount, 0) AS average_saving_amount, COALESCE(feed_stats.post_count, 0) AS post_count, COALESCE(feed_stats.received_like_count, 0) AS received_like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE message.user_id = users.id AND message.message_type = 'REPLY' ) AS comment_count FROM users LEFT JOIN challenge ON challenge.id = users.current_challenge_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT feed.user_id, SUM(feed.saving_amount) AS total_saving_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN feed.created_at >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AND feed.created_at < DATE_ADD( CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) THEN feed.saving_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS current_month_saving_amount, SUM( CASE WHEN feed.created_at >= DATE_SUB( CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) AND feed.created_at < CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) THEN feed.saving_amount ELSE 0 END ) AS previous_month_saving_amount, COUNT(*) AS verification_count, ROUND(AVG(feed.saving_amount), 0) AS average_saving_amount, COUNT(*) AS post_count, SUM(feed.like_count) AS received_like_count FROM feed WHERE feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY feed.user_id ) feed_stats ON feed_stats.user_id = users.id WHERE users.id = #{userId}

WITH RECURSIVE periods AS ( SELECT 1 AS period_order,
DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (#{bucketCount} - 1) DAY)
DATE_SUB( CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE), INTERVAL (#{bucketCount} - 1) MONTH )
AS period_start UNION ALL SELECT period_order + 1,
DATE_ADD(period_start, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
DATE_ADD(period_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
FROM periods WHERE period_order < #{bucketCount} ) SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(periods.period_start, '%Y-%m-%d')
DATE_FORMAT(periods.period_start, '%Y-%m')
AS month, COALESCE(SUM(feed.saving_amount), 0) AS saving_amount FROM periods LEFT JOIN feed ON feed.user_id = #{userId} AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL AND feed.created_at >= periods.period_start AND feed.created_at <
DATE_ADD(periods.period_start, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
DATE_ADD(periods.period_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
GROUP BY periods.period_order, periods.period_start ORDER BY periods.period_order

SELECT feed.id AS feed_id, feed.challenge_id, feed.caption, feed.thumbnail_url, feed.media_url, feed.media_type, feed.like_count, feed.created_at FROM feed WHERE feed.user_id = #{userId} AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' AND feed.file_deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY feed.like_count DESC, feed.created_at DESC, feed.id LIMIT 3
